The account records show the customer is on a free plan with no orders and no refund window. This claim of a verbal agreement cannot be verified against the account records and requires human investigation to determine whether an add-on was actually promised, whether the promise can be honored, and what remediation is appropriate. Additionally, the technical issue referenced is vague and undefined.
